universal-3-5-pro.description: Universal-3.5 Pro — flagship multilingual transcription with diarization
universal-3-5-pro.pricingNotes: Universal-3.5 Pro pre-recorded transcription is $0.21/hour plus $0.02/hour for speaker diarization. The default inclusive rate is $0.23/hour; disabling diarization subtracts the add-on. Free allowances, discounts, taxes and credits are excluded. Timing estimates remain provisional.

limits.notes: AssemblyAI allows larger remote URLs than upload API submissions. The current CLI uploads first, so effectiveBytes tracks the smaller upload cap.
